integrity: The source paper and accompanying symmetry-search program define the normalized four-dimensional frame assignment and parity convention. The complete 30-subgroup centralizer product, Burnside quotient and exact stabilizer census were independently recomputed from first principles; all detailed counts agreed with the published finding. This arithmetic is a symmetry census, not a coarsening-closure certificate.
scientific_limitations: Normalized U4 candidate-space symmetry classification only: the outer origin frame is fixed, no coarsening closure, tightness or enclosure is established, and no four-dimensional monotile existence/nonexistence conclusion is claimed.
title: Complete coordinate-symmetry census for the normalized four-dimensional chair search
